pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

experiment: E10 to E12, the bench of the informative chart (protocol sections 16 to 18)

views.judge: the whole image, with the frame
views.soloist: the columns 2 .. last - 1 of the inside of the image and no frame; the rest is set to zero in normalised units

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.eps: the unit noise of the frame, the same at the four levels
keys.a: frame value shown, shape (4, N): a = mu_d (2y - 1) + sd_d eps, one row per level
keys.z_H: the judge H (plus network, mu = 1, half A, whole image), shape (4, N): one row per level
keys.z_C: the judge trained with frames of level d, read at level d, shape (4, N)
keys.z_M: the soloist on its own, shape (N): it does not see the frame
keys.z_R: the branch on its own, shape (4, 4, N): built for level t (first index), read at level d (second index). The partner built for t is z_M + z_R[t]
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent eps, the same at the four levels and at the two views

machines.M: cross-entropy on half B, on the machine's part of the inside, no frame
machines.R_t: a branch that sees only the frame, trained from scratch on half B on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_M + z_branch (H and M frozen, eval mode), with training frames of level t
machines.C_d: the network and seed of H, trained on half A with frames of level d

frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
torch_seeds: crc32('trace/<task>/s<seed>/<H|M|ramo>') & 0x7fffffff; every C_d has the seed of H; the four branches of a unit have the same seed; M and the branches have the same seeds at the two views

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip
